notes.title: First Level - Tips and Tricks
notes.content:
Hello! This is Stephen here. We've seen that people have been having issues getting past the first area. While we wanted this level to be difficult, we didn't want it to be a breaking point for people. In order to make this area a little easier, we will direct your attention to the old woman living in the middle of town.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26168422/4b1a12c1a3da3e44ba3d7bf6306cddf083fe9f51.jpg[/img]

With a little bit of community service under your belt, the first area should be no problem.

Thank you everyone for checking out our game, hopefully we can make it a good experience for everyone!

- Stephen
